blocks.text: This page tracks the Tsawwassen MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for September 2026: $1,113,100 for a typical home, down 4.3% over twelve months.
Tsawwassen benchmark prices and trends, September 2026

A typical Tsawwassen home carried an MLS® Home Price Index benchmark of $1,113,100 in September 2026. That is little changed at +1.0% on the month, down 3.1% over three months, down 2.0% over six months and down 4.3% over the year. Over three years it is down 10.7%, and over five years little changed at +0.7%.
The weakest one-year move in Tsawwassen was for an apartment homes at −12.2%; the strongest was a detached home at −1.7%.
The gap between a detached home ($1,508,500) and an apartment ($556,000) is $952,500, and a townhouse ($886,000) sits $330,000 above the apartment benchmark.
Against Greater Vancouver, where the all-home benchmark was $1,075,900, Tsawwassen is 3.5% above. Over the year Greater Vancouver moved down 5.5% against down 4.3% here.
Of the 20 areas this board reports, Tsawwassen ranks 7 by all-home benchmark, with Vancouver East above it at $1,120,200 and Squamish below it at $1,091,800.

Detached homes in Tsawwassen: benchmark $1,508,500, up 2.9% in a month, down 1.9% in three months, little changed at −0.5% in six months, down 1.7% in a year, down 5.7% in three years and up 4.9% in five. That is 15.5% below the detached benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,784,700).

Townhouse homes in Tsawwassen: benchmark $886,000, down 4.3% in a month, down 5.2% in three months, down 4.3% in six months, down 8.8% in a year, down 14.4% in three years and little changed at −0.7% in five. That is 12.9% below the townhouse benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,016,700).

Apartment homes in Tsawwassen: benchmark $556,000, down 4.2% in a month, down 10.6% in three months, down 9.8% in six months, down 12.2% in a year, down 20.6% in three years and down 4.2% in five. That is 18.5% below the apartment benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($682,500).
